links.outcome: Human-evaluated safety and usability of answers
links.effect: Safety and usability significantly higher than LLMs without RAG (no numeric values reported in abstract); RAGAS scores for the KG-based system: faithfulness 0.9375, answer relevancy 0.9686, context recall 0.9500
links.quote: In human evaluations, the levels of safety and usability are significantly higher than those of LLMs without using RAG.
